Added laundry, wifi (paid park-wide), the booking rules. Not stated: site count, max rig length, season. Note: dropped the price and RV Life text (now in fees/rating).
flags: Price gate: base $72.95/night daily (Basic site, the operator's Newbook page, 2026-10-21), over US$50; no gateway within 40 km (nearest: Tampa 51 km, Walt Disney World 61 km, St. Petersburg 78 km, gateways.py).

Long-stay character: the site calls itself a '55+ community' and 'active retirement community' (home page title '55+ Community RV Park'), the rates page leads with monthly, 6-month and 7-month/5-month-storage packages and yearly leases, and seasonal/annual occupants get background checks. Daily and weekly nights ARE sold online, so it may pass the five-test rule, but it looks mostly seasonal. The FAQ contradicts the 55+ line ('an inclusive, non-denominational, family-friendly campground that welcomes both seasonal and short-term guests'); the age line in the note was left as the home page states it.
